offers_products.reason: Sells EHR and information system software to hospitals and clinics, including coding technology.

offers_services.reason: Provides outsourced revenue cycle management, complete business office and medical coding services for hospitals.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are rural and community hospitals, ambulatory clinics and physicians, not individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Hospitals, critical access facilities, health systems and clinics buy its EHR software and revenue cycle services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing RCM outsourcing paid as a percentage of collections, plus EHR support and subscription-style contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Hospitals need billing, coding and health records to operate and get paid, even in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue cycle services are billed continuously as a share of collections; sales are recurring rather than single large purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Large part is EHR software and technology; RCM services are staff-based, but the software and technology mix puts it below half.

large_customers.reason: Focus is small rural, critical access and community hospitals and clinics, not large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and business-office services need people and technology, not plants, fleets or property.

notes: Mix of EHR software and RCM services; the people_delivered answer could change if outsourced services are the larger part.
